title: Whether a member has paid for MettleUp Plus is known only to the phone, so a changed phone or a blocked Google Play keeps Plus open
what: Once MettleUp Plus is switched on, the app decides who has paid only from a note it keeps on the phone. No MettleUp server ever records or checks a purchase. When Google Play cannot be asked, the app keeps what it last knew, so a member who is refunded or cancels and keeps the phone from reaching Google Play keeps every paid feature. Someone who edits the phone's stored note (a rooted phone) gets Plus without paying.
expected: A purchase is checked against Google Play on the server and tied to the member's MettleUp account, and paid features close when Google Play says the purchase is gone.
fix_line: Check each Plus purchase on the server with Google Play and keep it on the member's account

title: One person can stop every member from speaking a help message for the rest of the day
what: Spoken help messages are limited to 60 a day per network address but only 1,000 a day for everyone together. Someone sending clips from about 17 addresses (easy on mobile data) uses up the whole day, and every member who taps Speak is then told they have spoken a lot today.
expected: One person or a few addresses cannot use up the spoken-message allowance of every member.
fix_line: Give the all-together ceiling room per gym or per proven account so strangers cannot fill it

title: A member's help message can step outside the box the AI is told to treat as only a question
what: The help AI is told to treat the message as a question only, and the message is wrapped in a marked box. But the member's own text can close that box early, and the screen name and app version the phone sends sit outside the box unchecked. A member can steer the AI into an answer that breaks its rules, for example promising a refund, shown under MettleUp's name. The answer goes back only to the person who asked, and is marked as written by AI, so others are not harmed; it could be screenshotted.
expected: Everything the phone sends is kept inside the marked box, and the box's end mark is removed from the member's text before it reaches the AI.
fix_line: Strip the box's end mark from the message and put screen and version inside it
